priority.override_reason: Rank-one controlflow-recursive is closed by the direct-leaf/frame and compact-dispatch rejection evidence. Ranks two through four have current receipts for the same compact ordinary-property allocation and mutation path. This changes the default descriptor representation itself; it neither learns constructor shapes nor retunes the rejected transition-shape, cache, or frame mechanisms.

mechanism.summary: Store an ordinary property whose descriptor is exactly writable, enumerable, configurable data as a key plus Value until an operation needs non-default descriptor state. Use the same value-only representation for every shared static object-literal shape, and materialize Property descriptors only for definition, accessor, integrity, or other descriptor mutations.
mechanism.generality: Eligibility follows only the live descriptor state of an ordinary object property. Every default data property in compact small storage or a compiler-shared literal shape uses the representation, independent of benchmark name, source path, constructor identity, field name, input, iteration count, or result. Accessors, non-default descriptors, symbols, exotics, structural mutations requiring generic storage, and values beyond the compact limit retain the current descriptor-bearing paths.
semantic_risks: preserving ordinary assignment, delete, redefinition, extensibility, and descriptor-query behavior while materializing a default descriptor before any operation that can observe or alter its attributes
preserving insertion order, duplicate literal key first-position and last-value semantics, and numeric-index-before-string enumeration across value-only to descriptor-bearing promotion
preserving named-property cache validity and live value visibility across value writes, descriptor mutation, small-storage promotion, and shaped-literal promotion
preserving sealed and frozen behavior by materializing descriptors before changing configurable or writable state
preserving accessor, Proxy, module-namespace, typed-array, array-exotic, and inherited-property fallbacks before any default-data representation is selected
